title: State Media and IRGC-Style Press Personas on X
question: Which accounts feeding anti-Israel/anti-Western narratives are state outlets, declared proxies, or manufactured press personas - and can any be tied with evidence to seed influencers?
scope: X public posts; T0 last 30 days for live anchors; T1 persona batch year 2026-01-01..now; EN/AR/FA/ES separate queries; Shadowgraph/Clemson ingested not copied.
publicInterestBasis: Distinguishing overt state outlets from covert manufactured personas matters for attribution discipline; ties to seed influencers bear on information-chain integrity.
confidence: **Confidence: high on cohort split & card-factory; medium on pipeline contact; fabricated-caption testing NOT done (flagged).**

bottomLine.text: **Batch-cohort split verified via API creation dates.** Of 18 tested handles: **11 live / 7 absent** (SPC_Press, Expres_Newsx, TNT_Today, OpsHQs, IR_HDX, Iran__Fire, SPX_Press all user-not-found — consistent with platform suspensions of the Shadowgraph set). The three surviving covert personas were all created in **2026**: GBC_Press (**Feb 28**), IRGC_Global (**Apr 9**), IRGC_Press (**Jul 18** — weeks old, 1,008 followers). This matches Shadowgraph's batch-year claim without reproducing their fingerprint method.

**Card factory confirmed:** @GBC_Press posts identical 🚨BREAKING cards on a **1–2 minute cadence** across unrelated topics (Trump-China arms; China joins SA genocide case; Fernando Torres Epstein; Spain ambassador recall; Bilzerian "parasites" quote; Israeli poll) — baseline views 435–714 with rare algorithmic breakouts (21K on a Dolly-Parton half-staff item that Gulag/Lucre/Wallace also covered — cross-lane echo).

**Overt vs covert separation maintained:** PressTV family (2010/2020/2022 creations) and Al Mayadeen family (2012/2013/2020) are institutionally distinct from the anonymous 2026 personas. Labels never merged.

**Pipeline contact is real but unproven for GBC:** both seeds routinely reference the *overt* family (PressTV/Mayadeen/Marandi queries hit 20-cap each). Direct GBC→seed reuse was **not** established this run — recorded as an honest negative (rel_04 low confidence).
**Fabricated-caption (claim-type-6) testing was not completed** — no video playback available; flagged as open work rather than silently skipped.
Marandi remains NAMED_PERSON professor; Cradle stays case-05 dual-home with **no state-adjacent upgrade evidence** this run.

limitations: API persona resolution (18 handles, creation timestamps) + feed sample + two pipeline searches. Shadowgraph ingested as pointer list with its own caveats preserved. Farsi/Arabic native passes and video work outstanding. Right-of-reply n/a for anonymous personas; overt outlets not alleged beyond classification. Validator: OK.

Shadowgraph's fingerprint methodology; Clemson's 62-account Americas set (named-example sampling deferred); talk2trav thread fetch (tool unavailable); Turkish/Russian relay handles; volume-collapse analysis around IRIB-strike dates; Spanish persona exhibits.
